The '''Evacuation of Excarga''' was a space battle in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] above the planet of [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The Republic forces were led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|another Jedi Knight]] and their objective was to destroy as many [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] as they could while keeping the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] from escaping the planet.

==Prelude==
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched an attack on the planet of [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]].<ref name="CWA" /> Following the Republic victory on the planet, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] tried to escape from the planet by dispatching [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] to retrieve their forces. However, the Republic fleet stopped the Separatist fleet from escaping the planet.<ref name="CWA" />
